notes.title: Update Notes for Game Version 0.6.0
notes.content:
New Additions:
  Integrated Steam Achievement system (as this is a newly added feature, some achievements may not support old save files, and there may still be some bugs).
  Clothing vending machine: Ninja.

Difficulty-related optimizations:
  Reduced the difficulty of Normal, Hard, and Nightmare modes.
  Regular monsters now have a chance to spawn in a weakened state, making them move slower (the chance decreases as difficulty increases).
  Challenge stages now have 1 to 3 fewer waves depending on the difficulty level.
  Added markers for key doors to the mini-map in Chapter 1.
  Reduced the difficulty of the bridge puzzle in Chapter 3.
  Increased the critical hit damage of the starting pistol (does not support old save files).
  Increased the critical hit damage of the starting shotgun (does not support old save files).
  Monsters now take double damage from any source when knocked down.
  Improved aim assist for better head locking.

Other optimizations:
  Fine-tuned the dismemberment sound effects.
  Slightly increased the attack range of the wrench.
  Continuously correcting translation errors.

Fixes:
  Fixed a bug where the trigger range for the opening cutscene of the Chapter 5 boss fight was too small.
  Fixed a bug where the enclosed elevator in Chapter 5 was misplaced after loading.
  Fixed incorrect collision detection for destructible obstacle crates.
  Fixed incorrect death effect positioning for axe-wielding monsters.
  Fixed a bug with the double-dog reward in Chapter 4.
  Fixed some clipping issues in certain areas of Chapter 5.

notes.title: Game Version 0.4.6.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Additions:
.Expanded Content: Added a new themed map.
.Added one melee weapon and two ranged weapons usable on the new map.
.New Aim Assist Feature: When enabled in settings, guns will automatically aim at an enemy's torso when raised. The assist activation distance scales with the setting level—higher values mean a larger range.
.New Crouch Mechanic:
    Crouching allows passage through low tunnels.
    Moving while crouched reduces the chance of alerting dormant monsters.
.Added Controller Vibration Settings.
.Each challenge map now includes a melee weapon.

Optimizations:
.Faster weapon switching.
.Removed the stomp mechanic as melee combat has been refined.
.Adjusted the initial weapon acquisition process in Story Mode.

.Improved rules for free outfits obtained in levels.
.Optimized enemy spawn locations in Challenge Mode.

Enhanced the fading effect of flames.

  RB acts as a modifier key:
  RB + A: Throw grenade
  RB + X: Quick heal
  RB + D-pad: Switch secondary weapon

.Added crouch toggle (press LS).

Bug Fixes:
.Fixed a bug where unequipping a weapon prevented other weapons from being activated.
.Fixed a bug where monsters grabbing the player while falling resulted in an empty grab.
.Fixed a bug where scoping in caused unintended weapon switching.
.Fixed a bug where explosives did not deal damage to downed monsters.

notes.title: Game Version 0.4.6 Update Notes
notes.content:
New Additions
Added a new defense-themed map to the themed map menu.
New weapons available on the new map: Heavy Sniper Rifle, Silver Pistol, and Assault Rifle.

Optimizations
Weapon System Overhaul
Weapons are now categorized as Primary and Secondary:
Primary Weapons (ranged): Right-click to aim, Left-click to fire.
Secondary Weapons (melee): Left-click to attack.

Combat Flow Improvements:
No need to manually switch between melee and ranged weapons.
1. Left-click alone triggers secondary melee attacks.
2. Right-click to aim first activates the primary weapon, converting left-click to fire.

Equipment Slots:
Primary Weapons: Up to 8 slots (cycle with Mouse Wheel, select via 1–8 keys).
Secondary Weapons: Up to 4 slots (cycle with Mouse Side Buttons or F5/F6, select via F1–F4).

Melee Combat Enhancements:
Smoother transitions between first and second melee combo strikes.
Second melee strike now includes a short dash.
Melee attacks automatically adjust to ground strikes when:
The camera is angled downward beyond a threshold.
Only downed enemies or crates are within attack range.

Dodge System Overhaul
Keybind Changes:
Dodge: Spacebar (replaces stomp).
Stomp: Moved to Alt key.

Dodge Mechanics:
Tap Spacebar to dodge backward; hold A/D + Spacebar to dodge left/right.
Dodge is now usable while aiming, mid-melee combo recovery, or during weapon firing animations.
Post-dodge: Chain directly into a second melee strike (ground strikes gain dash properties).
Brief damage reduction during the initial dodge frames.

Other Improvements
Enemy Adjustments
Added telegraphing animations for enemy grab/bite attacks.
Enemies now perform roar animations.
Improved enemy AI refresh rate and attack hitbox detection.
Added execution skills for elite enemies.

UI/UX & Visuals
Updated new player tutorials for the revamped weapon system.
Added black soft-edge effects to sniper rifle scopes.
Revamped keyboard keybind visuals.
Quick Heal key remapped to T (to prevent accidental grenade throws).
Sprint reloading no longer cancels sprint.
Added blinking effects to weapon upgrades and backpack modules in the inventory UI.

Character & Gear
Upgraded the default Wrench melee weapon.
Redesigned the protagonist’s default outfit.

Smoother breathing animations across poses.

Bug Fixes
Fixed challenge map medal display issues.
Corrected unlocked outfit count errors in the wardrobe UI.
Increased aim-down-sights speed for all weapons.
Optimized map lighting and resolved enemy pathing/stuck issues.

Known Issues
Controller support for the new weapon system is incomplete.
Old save files may require re-equipping weapons.

notes.title: The game update to 0.3.8
notes.content:
[h1] Game updated to 0.3.8 [/h1]
Mainly focused on optimizing various opinions collected in previous versions
1. Change the backpack shortcut key to TAB, and the original I key can still be used
2. Automatically merge ammunition into the backpack when picking it up
3. The backpack supports mouse operation
4. The keyboard operation inside the backpack has now been changed to WSAD, and the original directional keys can still be used
5. Added instructions for all props in the backpack
6. The rules for discarding items have been adjusted, and the encryption key can be discarded without occupying any more space
7. Pistol initialization capacity+2
8. Enhanced the performance of shotguns
9. Shock bombs increase damage and range, reducing 1-second delay time
10. Accelerated the stepping speed and slightly increased the range
11. Modified the melee action of the wrench
12. Added the setting for reversing the Y-axis
The perspective angle of the field of view can now be adjusted in three levels
14. Field of view sensitivity and aiming sensitivity can now be set separately
15. Running [CTRL/SHIFE] now adds a selection setting of [hold down] or [switch]
16. Added several sets of clothing
17. The settings interface has been updated with illustrations of the keyboard and controller
18. Continuously increase language support for other countries
19. Rapid treatment has been added, and treatment drugs can now be quickly used by pressing the H key. Guidance on usage has also been added
20. Fixed the missing background music during battles
21. Fixed the issue of no change in height when wearing high heels
22. Adjusted the position of some supplies
23. Removed vending machine 648
24. Add game style filters and black and white video tape styles
25. Added guidance prompts for clearance rewards
26. Optimized the storage interface
27. After triggering the plot, being attacked by monsters has been corrected. Now entering the plot animation, monsters will be in a stopped state
28. Fixed the issue of ventilation ducts penetrating the map
29. Fixed the issue of some maps being used to brush monsters in the void
30. Optimized some of the strange models
31. AMD FSR3 support has been added, which can now be selected in the settings. If it doesn't work, restart the game after setting it up
32. Add Chinese voice support
33. Improved the speed of entering aiming mode
34. Other minor revisions
